Welcome to my blog! This is where I'll share my ramblings, on anything ranging from medicine and public health to software engineering, data science, and the interesting problems that emerge at their intersections.

## Why Write?

I've been trying to run a blog since I was 11, that's more than 20 years ago.
What happened now ? I don't know. I guess I got old enough to realise how important writing is ?
Or maybe I'm just in a phase that will last two weeks.

Who knows ?
